correctness.rationale: The main inequality follows from pairwise disjoint stationary cylinder events indexed by codeword and covering offset; the mean-length corollaries follow from AM-GM and verified convexity identities.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Modern variable-length non-overlap literature was checked for the stationary weighted inequality and average-length consequences; an earlier generating-function framework is explicitly acknowledged as closely related, and older comma-free literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result gives a source-sensitive structural inequality and yields an additional log-log lower-order term in minimum average length for fixed alphabets, directly complementing recent work on the average-length question.

prior_scientific_review.disclaimer: Preserved prior scientific assessment; it is not the independent audit.
